content: Wain oh sakau kin kahrehiong uhk lokaia laud oh mwomwen pweipwei. Aramas me kin sakaula me nohn pweipwei.
Ke en masak nanmwarki men me engiengdahr, rasehng laion me wie ngiringir men. Pwe ma ke pahn kahngiangihada, met rasehng me ke men kemehla pein kowe.
Me pweipwei men sohte lipilipil kak tapihada akamai; a me keieu kesempwal ma ke sohte iang akamai.
Soumwet men me kin pohnkahke en weirada pwelen eh mwetuwel ni ahnsawi, sohte pahn ahneki mehkot ni ahnsoun dolung.
Madamadau en aramas kin rasehng pihl me mi nan pwarer loal, ahpw mehmen me ahneki erpit kak idipasang.
Koaros kin koasoia duwen ar mehlel oh loalopwoat, ahpw song ma ke kak diarada emen me mehlel oh loalopwoat.
Seri kan kin paiamwahu ma arail pahpa kin lelepek oh wia dahme pwung.
Nanmwarki kin ket nan mwoalen tenek oh mwahngih me suwed ni eh kin mahsanihada.
Mie me kak koasoia me eh lamalam me mwakelekel, me solahr dipe?
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki aramas me kin doadoahngki mehn tenek oh mehn sosohng sapwung.
Seri men pil kin kasalehda mwomwe sang ni eh wiewia kan; ke kak ese ma e lelepek oh mwahu.
KAUN-O ketikihdo pwoaren masatail pwe kitail en kilangki wasa, oh salengatail pwe kitail en rongki wasa.
Ma ke mwahuki memeir ahnsou koaros, ke pahn semwehmwehla. Soupisengki doadoahk ahnsou koaros, e ahpw pahn mie omw tungoal kisin mwenge.
Me kin pwainda dipwisou kan kin kaulimki pweilaud en dipwisou, ahpw ni eh kin pedohi kohkohla, e kin suweikiseli eh pwainda dipwisou ni pweitikitik.
Ma ke ese dahme ke ndindahn, eri, ke ahnekier mehkot me kesempwal sang kohl de takai kesempwal akan.
Mehmen me nohk pweipwei oh inoukihda en pwainla en mehn liki men eh pweipwand, e konehngete sapwe en kohsang oh pwainla pweipwando ma anahnpe mie.
Dahme ke aleier sang ni tiahk en mwersuwed, pahn kaperen rasehng mwenge me keieu iou, ahpw e pahn mwadangete duwehla pihk nan ewomw.
Ale kaweid mwahu, ke ahpw pahn pweida; ke dehr tangowohng nan mahwen ehu ni omw sohte wiahda koasoandi ehu.
Liketihti sohte kak karirihala mehkot rir. Ke dehr patehng aramas me ewen wedei.
Ma ke keriahla semomw oh inomw, omw mour pahn imwisekla rasehng lamp ehu me kin kunla nan rot.
Uwen mengei en omw pahn diar omw pai, ih uwen eh sohte pahn wia kamwahu ehu ong uhk.
Ke dehr pein pwukoahki wia dupukpen sapwung ehu. Likih KAUN-O oh e ahpw pahn ketin kapwungala.
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki me kin doadoahngki mehn tenek oh mehn sosohng sapwung.
KAUN-O ketin koasoanedier alatail; eri, ihs me kak wehwehki mehnia ahl me eh weweid loale?
Medemedewe mahs mwohn omw pahn inoukihong KAUN-O meirong ehu. Ke kakete koluhkihla mwuhr oh nsensuwedkihla.
Nanmwarki kupwurokong men pahn diarada ihs me kin wiewia me sapwung, oh pahn ketin kaloke ni sohte mahk.
KAUN-O ketikihong kitail mehn madamadau oh kadeikpen loale; eri, kitail sohte kak pein ekihsang kitail audepen loalatail.
Nanmwarki men pahn ketiket nan mwoale erein eh pahn kakaun ni mehlel, pwung, oh pahrek.
Kitail kin kapinga kehlail en me pwulopwul kan oh wauneki me moangepwet kan.
Ekei pak e kin wia mehkot me kamedek kitail en kin wekidala mwekid kan en atail mour.
